question: Krishnadeva Raya composed a work on __________ in Telugu known as the Amuktamalyada.
solution:
The correct answer is __**statecraft.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The correct answer is option 1, i.e., statecraft.**
 
• Krishnadeva Raya was a ruler of the **Vijayanagara Empire, and he was known for his administrative skills and patronage of arts and literature.**
 
• Amuktamalyada is a Telugu composition that describes the story of the wedding of Lord Vishnu and Andal, a devotee of Vishnu. The work also includes advice on statecraft and governance.
 
• The work is considered a masterpiece of Telugu literature and is admired for its poetic beauty and insights into politics and ethics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Vijayanagara Empire:

 
 
• Vijayanagara or “city of victory” was the name of both a city and an empire.
 
• The empire was founded in the fourteenth century (1336 AD) by Harihara and Bukka of the Sangama dynasty.
 
• They made Hampi the capital city.
 
• In 1986, Hampi was declared a World Heritage site by UNESCO.
